newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market at a standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market at a standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill on Monday morning. Steers and heifers were not established on a dressed basis delivered, (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said. Dressed Basis Steers - No confirmed sales Dressed Basis Heifers - No confirmed sales.

No sales on slaughter steers or heifers reported. Buyer inquiry and seller interest light. Slaughter Steers - No confirmed sales Slaughter Heifers - No confirmed sales. Sales confirmed - None For the week - 200
